content: Furthermore, grassroots marketing through sponsoring and presenting at local chapter meetings of professional bodies like ISACA, (ISC)², and OWASP in Johannesburg, Cape Town, and Durban can build credibility with technical practitioners who often act as key influencers in purchasing decisions. Despite a superior product and a strong channel, the sales process will inevitably encounter client objections that must be skillfully addressed.
